Home.title: Find your way. Keep the journey.
Home.description: Discover GPX tracks on a map and build a collection of your own. Find a route to explore, revisit a favorite, or share a journey worth following.
Home.notice: Early in development. Discovery, accounts, and uploads are planned, not yet available.
Home.publicAccess: The plan: public tracks open to everyone, with no account needed to explore.
Home.mapLabel: Illustration of multiple tracks across a topographic map
Home.mapCaption: Explore by place, direction, and terrain.
Home.mapDisclosure: Illustrative map only — not a working search.

discover.eyebrow: More than a list of routes
discover.title: See where a track can take you.

place.title: Start with a place
place.description: Explore public tracks in the area you’re looking at. Show several on the map to compare where they go.

direction.title: Follow your direction
direction.description: Draw an arrow to find nearby tracks heading roughly your way, not just starting near the same point.

fit.title: Find the right fit
fit.description: Narrow your search by tags, distance, and elevation changes. Open a track to read its description and download the GPX.

how.title: From a little curiosity to your next journey.

explore.label: 01 / Explore
explore.title: Find a track
explore.description: Move around the map, refine your search, and discover tracks shared by the community.

details.label: 02 / Take a closer look
details.title: Get the details
details.description: See the route on a map, read the uploader’s notes, and download its GPX file for your own navigation tools.

own.label: 03 / Make it yours
own.title: Bring your own GPX
own.description: Create an account to upload your tracks, organize your collection, and choose what to share.

collection.title: Explore freely. Build your own atlas.
collection.description: Public discovery won’t require an account. Signing up will give your own journeys a home.
collection.notice: Account creation and track uploads are coming as the project develops.

keep.title: Keep your GPX collection together.
keep.description: Upload your tracks and find them again on a map.

private.title: Choose what stays private.
private.description: Keep a track just for yourself or publish it for everyone. Only public tracks can be shared.

share.title: Share something worth following.
share.description: Public tracks will appear in discovery and on your public profile.

details.title: Keep the details useful.
details.description: Update descriptions, tags, and visibility. Track geometry editing is outside the scope of Track Atlas.

openSource.title: A shared map. An open project.
openSource.description: Track Atlas is open source. Explore the code on GitHub, report a bug, suggest an idea, or help build what comes next.

Home.status: Early in development · Built in the open

Metadata.title: Track Atlas — Find your way. Keep the journey.
Metadata.description: An open-source home for GPX journeys: map-first discovery and personal track collections. Discover what’s planned for Track Atlas, currently in early development.
